title: The Importance of Banking Through An Empathetic Lens
summary: Joining FinextraTV at Temenos Community Forum, Muhammad Faisal Anwar, CTO, HBL discussed core modernisation and lessons learned along the journey. When thinking about whether core modernisation was 'just an IT problem, Anwar explained that banks falter when they don't first create a problem statement and what the core journey will solve. Equally, Anwar described the importance of empathy, explaining how employees should be regarded as ambassadors for the business, and how their satisfaction and morale are just as crucial. He went on to advise banks to see customer transactions as 'lifestyles' more than products or services - a house, a car, a holiday.

title: What's the Right Level of Friction for Pay-by-Bank?
summary: Joining FinextraTV at Payments Unleashed in London, Dean Wallace, Director, Consumer Payments Modernisation, ACI Worldwide discussed the evolution of pay-by-bank and some of the current obstacles. Wallace provided context to the growth, describing how many have tried to get rid of cards and pay-by-bank is perhaps the most succesful, but is still not an aggressive threat, given how ingrained cards still are. Looking at multi-rail environments, Wallace explains that the way that banks or cooperatives transition customers to new approaches and away from cards will define whether they stay loyal. He goes on to discuss the presence of friction and how some level allows a customer to feel safe, but too much will ruin the experience.
